passages.title: IT service notice
passages.text:
IT SERVICE NOTICE - Scheduled Network Upgrade

When: Saturday, October 11, from 10:00 P.M. to Sunday, October 12, at 2:00 A.M.

Affected services: office Wi-Fi, remote VPN access, and company e-mail. The shared drive will remain available inside the building through wired connections only.

Why: We are replacing the main network switch to support the new cloud-based accounting software that goes live on November 3.

What you should do: Save and close all work by 9:45 P.M. Employees who need to work during the upgrade should contact the IT Help Desk (ext. 4400) by Wednesday, October 8, so that a wired workstation can be reserved.

passages.title: Weekend work
passages.text:
To: IT Help Desk
From: Mei Tanaka, Accounting
Date: October 7
Subject: Weekend work during upgrade

Hello,

I am responsible for the month-end report, which is due Monday morning. I had planned to work from home on Saturday evening, from about 8:00 P.M. to midnight. After reading your notice, I realize that will not be possible for part of that time.

Could you reserve a wired workstation for me from 10:00 P.M.? I will be in the Accounting office on the third floor.

Thank you,
Mei Tanaka

questions.q: According to the notice, why is the upgrade being done?
options: To move the IT Help Desk

why.vi: Mục "Why": thay switch để hỗ trợ phần mềm kế toán mới.
why.en: The notice says the switch is replaced to support the new accounting software.

questions.q: What are employees asked to do by 9:45 P.M. on Saturday?

why.vi: "Save and close all work by 9:45 P.M."
why.en: The notice asks employees to save and close all work by 9:45 P.M.

questions.trap: Liên hệ Help Desk là hạn thứ Tư 8/10, không phải 9:45 tối thứ Bảy.

questions.q: What is indicated about Ms. Tanaka's request?
options: It was sent before the deadline
It was sent after the upgrade
It was sent to the wrong department

why.vi: Hạn là thứ Tư, 8/10; cô viết ngày 7/10, nên đúng hạn.
why.en: The deadline is October 8 and she wrote on October 7.

questions.q: What would Ms. Tanaka be unable to do from home after 10:00 P.M. on Saturday?
options: Connect to the company network remotely

why.vi: Cô định làm việc từ nhà, mà VPN (truy cập từ xa) bị ngừng từ 10 giờ tối.
why.en: She planned to work from home, but remote VPN access is unavailable after 10:00 P.M.

questions.q: What is most likely true about Ms. Tanaka's department?
options: It is moving to the third floor
It will use the new cloud-based software

why.vi: Phần mềm kế toán đám mây dùng từ 3/11, và cô làm ở bộ phận Accounting với báo cáo cuối tháng.
why.en: The new accounting software goes live November 3, and she works in Accounting.

passages.title: Orbis Thermostat FAQ
passages.text:
Orbis Thermostat T2 | Frequently Asked Questions

Which devices can control the thermostat?
The Orbis app works with phones running Android 10 or later and iOS 15 or later. Tablets are not supported at this time.

What does the warranty cover?
Orbis T2 units have a two-year limited warranty covering defects in parts and workmanship. Damage caused by incorrect installation is not covered unless the installation was carried out by an Orbis Certified Installer.

How do I update the software?
Updates install automatically overnight when the thermostat is connected to Wi-Fi.

My screen is blank. What should I do?
Hold the center button for ten seconds to restart. If the problem continues, contact Support with your serial number, found on the back of the unit.

passages.title: Blank screen
passages.text:
To: Orbis Support
From: Paul Ferreira
Date: February 12
Subject: Thermostat screen blank

Hello,

I bought my Orbis T2 thermostat in March last year and had it installed by an electrician from my building's maintenance team. Last night the screen went blank. I held the center button as instructed on your website, but nothing changed. I am using a tablet at the moment because my phone is being repaired, so I could not check the status in the app.

Could you tell me whether this is covered by the warranty? The serial number is OT2-88231.

Thank you,
Paul Ferreira

questions.q: Why did Mr. Ferreira write to Orbis Support?
options: To ask for an app update
To report a problem with his thermostat

why.vi: Màn hình bị đen và anh hỏi có được bảo hành không.
why.en: His screen went blank and he asks about warranty coverage.

questions.q: What did Mr. Ferreira do before writing?

why.vi: "I held the center button as instructed on your website".
why.en: He held the center button as the website instructs.

questions.q: What is suggested about Mr. Ferreira's tablet?
options: It is more than two years old
It cannot run the Orbis app

why.vi: Trang FAQ ghi "Tablets are not supported", mà anh đang dùng tablet.
why.en: The FAQ says tablets are not supported, and he is using a tablet.

questions.trap: Anh nói điện thoại đang sửa, không nói tablet cũ hay cần cập nhật.

questions.q: What is true about Mr. Ferreira's thermostat?
options: It has a different serial number
It was installed by an Orbis employee
It is still within the warranty period
It was bought two years ago

why.vi: Mua tháng Ba năm ngoái, giờ là tháng Hai, vẫn trong thời hạn hai năm.
why.en: He bought it last March and now it is February, within the two-year warranty.

questions.q: What will Orbis Support most likely ask Mr. Ferreira next?
options: Whether he lives in an apartment
Whether his phone is under warranty
Whether the thermostat is connected to the internet
Whether his electrician was an Orbis Certified Installer

why.vi: Bảo hành không bao gồm lỗi lắp đặt trừ khi do Orbis Certified Installer làm; anh nhờ một thợ điện của tòa nhà.
why.en: Incorrect installation is only covered if done by a certified installer, and he used a building electrician.

questions.trap: Wi-Fi chỉ liên quan cập nhật tự động, không phải màn hình đen.
